ablation.notes: Phase 4F.1: 3-Level Haar DWT lowpass. Extends 4D breakthrough (2-Level, clip=0.7301) to 3 levels. LL_3 (4x4) = global composition (near-constant); LH_3/HL_3/HH_3 (4x4) = meso-strokes; LH_2/HL_2/HH_2 (8x8) = macro-strokes; LH_1/HL_1/HH_1 (16x16) = micro-noise. Risk: LL_3 (4x4) may be too aggressive (near-global-average), losing structural detail. Tests if deeper decomposition continues the +0.004/level trend or hits diminishing returns.
